messages:
jake-sales: Customer requires our pen-test report, vuln-scan outputs, and a SIG/CAIQ CSV mapping for their vendor intake. Need ETA and owners.

jake-sales: Uploaded sanitized attachments: <https://files.redwood.com/share/pen_test_q1_2026_sanitary.pdf|pen_test_q1_2026_sanitary.pdf> and <https://files.redwood.com/share/scan_output_2026-04-01.zip|scan_output_2026-04-01.zip>

secops-bot: Upload logged (id u-2026-990). Access granted to procurement-sme@acme.com (view only).

mira-sec: Quick review: 3 findings total: 2 medium, 1 low. Medium A requires vendor patch (crypto lib). Medium B is gateway config. Low is dependency upgrade. No PII in PDFs.

lee-runtime: Owners: gateway config -> lee-runtime (INF-4520); vendor patch -> lee-runtime coordinating with upstream. I'll aim for gateway rollout 2026-04-10.

procurement-sme: Our risk team needs: per-find owner, remediation ETA, re-scan date, and a signed attestation once re-scan completes. CSV format: find_id,cve,control_id,control_family,remediation_status.

mira-sec: Proposed timeline:
- 2026-04-10: gateway config prod rollout (owner lee-runtime)
- 2026-04-15: expected vendor patch (vendor permitting)
- 2026-04-16: canary verification + 24h monitoring
- 2026-04-18: internal re-scan (job rs-2026-701)
- 2026-04-19: deliver re-scan report + CSV mapping + signed attestation on letterhead

qa-eng: Post-deploy verification command we'll run:
```
./infra/tools/vuln_check --target gateway --ids FIND-2026-501,FIND-2026-502 --output rescan-2026-04-18.json
```

secops-bot: Re-scan job rs-2026-701 scheduled 2026-04-18 02:45 UTC. Results will be archived to /sec/runs/rs-2026-701.

mira-sec: I'll produce the SIG/CAIQ CSV and the attestation template. Example CSV line: FIND-2026-501,CVE-2026-1350,CC-7.2,Configuration Management,in_progress

jake-sales: I'll be the procurement contact and will forward the final bundle to the buyer. Action items: lee to confirm rollout windows by EOD, mira to attach CSV + signed attestation after re-scan, secops-bot to post results.

procurement-sme: Compensating controls acceptable if vendor delays, but need docs and monitoring evidence.

mira-sec: Noted. We'll include WAF rule docs if used as compensating control.

jake-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with the proposed schedule and confirm once we have re-scan artifacts. :thumbsup:
